The Verona Italian Style Bed is an upholstered bed frame with a richly padded, grandly proportioned headboard that gives the room an Italian-inspired look. It is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Grand proportioned luxury headboard
  • Deeply padded premium upholstered headboard
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £331.99; Small Double (4FT) £363.99; Double (4FT6) £389.99; King (5FT) £415.99; Super King (6FT) £474.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Will the Verona suit a large bedroom?

The headboard is grandly proportioned, so it works best where it has space. See our how to measure your bedroom for a new bed, or call 07417 439197 for advice.

What fabrics can I choose?

Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Vertical Channel Kids Bed has fine vertical channelling across a padded headboard. It is sized for a child's room, tall enough to make a statement without overwhelming a smaller space, and fully upholstered. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Fine vertical channel headboard detailing
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Solid, sturdy frame
  • Rounded edges throughout
  • Handmade to order in West Yorkshire, UK
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame that is fully upholstered. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress. If you are unsure which mattress suits your size, especially the Kids Single (2.6FT), call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How is it different from the Horizontal Channel Kids Bed?

The channels run vertically here, and horizontally on the Horizontal Channel Kids bed.

Does it have a footboard?

Yes. It has fully upholstered enclosed side panels and a matching footboard.

What sizes does it come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT), all at £299.00.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p4.descriptionHtml:
A timeless sleigh shape with modern storage. The Windermere Sleigh Ottoman Bed has a scrolled, deep-buttoned headboard and a matching curved footboard, with a gas-lift base that opens to reveal storage under the whole mattress.

Key features

  • Scrolled sleigh headboard and footboard with deep buttoning
  • Gas-lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress
  • Fully upholstered in plush velvet, with no exposed legs
  • Handmade to order in our West Yorkshire workshop

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our pocket sprung, memory foam and pillow top mattresses to complete the bed.

Delivery

Free delivery to addresses across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
